title: Extend tmp sweep to the ledger root and derived dirs
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `sweepTmpDirs` (src/core/store.ts:57-83) sweeps `*.tmp` in tasks/claims/messages/issues/handoffs but NOT the ledger root (where `mutation-intent.json.tmp` can be orphaned by a crash between temp write and rename) nor reports/context/views (where `writeText` in src/core/generate.ts:21-25 leaves temp files). Extend the sweep to cover those locations, keeping the under-lock invariant.
acceptance: Orphaned `*.tmp` files in the ledger root and in `.waystation/reports`, `.waystation/context`, and `.waystation/views` are removed by the first lock sweep.
The sweep remains under the ledger lock; no live writer's temp is ever removed.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #14 (cosmetic). Touches src/core/store.ts, also touched by task-lock-contended-wiring and task-sse-event-coverage; coordinate.
